Eight original text bodies were physically read completely (76,023 bytes), and eight later entries reuse exact whole-byte identity. Four assigned dark and four associated light variants were freshly viewed whole; four SVG theme pairs match selected geometry and visible text. Five later parents and five complete differences, 118 matching section signatures and twelve complete image-index rows retain their separate scopes. The frozen inventory has 29 scientific or premise-backed requirements, 19 directly in construction sources, and six construction boundaries. Forty exact field references appear in seven actual static readers. Two existing owners receive three notes/link field changes; old notes and links are exact prefixes, and no new record, alias, relation, date, registration, lead or summary consumer changes. Ten publication identities and complete abstracts, fourteen targeted article blocks and seven curated entry selections retain their stated depth. Failed responses, reCAPTCHA bodies and the NCBI metadata stub earn no content credit. All 44 source/context version identities and 42 raw capture receipts pass. Full gates pass 293 files and 3,101 tests with two skips, and seven entity/context exports plus 42 Markdown passages pass. Fifteen earlier HLA bindings are preserved without excerpt, grade or source-depth change. Supporting records carry no source-point credit. No ordinary grade, main/live, independent, expert, owner, learner, language, browser, mobile or accessibility acceptance is granted.
